verdict.rationale: Dots' own docs say the dot can use background agents to work on several things in parallel, which is a thin, first-party basis for acting on multiple items at once. Nothing documents a true bulk operation, such as applying one action across a large set of emails, documents or issues in a single request. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability across many items, documented scale or limits, examples of multi-item actions in connected apps, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.
